evidence.observation: The speaker links sourcing cargo crates and selling them to receiving in-game money.
evidence.quote: And once you guys have sourced enough crates and you guys are satisfied with the amount of money that you guys have racked up. Inside of your cargo crate warehouse. All you have to do is simply sell it whenever you guys are ready. And then boom you guys will get your money.

evidence.observation: The frame shows a gameplay avatar on an airfield and a mission banner reading 'STEAL CARGO' with instructions to take Jewelry & Gemstones and deliver them to the Hangar.
